_comment: Aider provider — requires aider installed (https://aider.chat). Uses --message-file - to read the prompt from stdin. Cloud mode requires an API key; local mode uses --model openai/<model> --openai-api-base to talk to an OpenAI-compatible local server (LM Studio, Ollama, etc.).

providers._comment: Cloud mode — uses your OpenAI account. Set OPENAI_API_KEY in your environment.
providers.name: aider

providers._comment: Local mode — uses LM Studio as the backend. No real API key needed; 'openai=lm-studio' is a dummy key.
providers.name: aider-lmstudio
